title: TaxoMFM: A Taxonomy-Aware Foundation Model for the Human Gut Microbiome
abstract: arXiv:2610.39316v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing gut microbiome foundation models typically use flat taxon representations, limiting their ability to exploit known taxonomic hierarchies. We introduce TaxoMFM, a microbiome foundation model that integrates taxonomic structure into self-supervised learning. TaxoMFM jointly learns abundance patterns across taxonomic ranks and relative proportions within groups through taxonomy-aware encoding and hierarchical compositional reconstruction. We further construct TaxoGut-HPP, comprising 100,806 gut microbiome profiles from 231 source cohorts and covering 40 classification and 8 regression tasks. TaxoMFM achieves competitive performance across disease, gut health, host trait, and liver ultrasound phenotype prediction. In cross-cohort zero-shot transfer, where target cohorts are excluded from both pretraining and downstream adaptation, TaxoMFM achieves AUROCs of 0.838, 0.736, and 0.722 for colorectal cancer, type 2 diabetes, and infl

translated_title: TaxoMFM：一个面向人类肠道微生物组的分类学感知基础模型
translated_abstract: 现有的肠道微生物组基础模型通常采用扁平的分类单元表示方式，限制了其利用已知分类层级结构的能力。我们提出了TaxoMFM，一个将分类学结构整合到自监督学习中的微生物组基础模型。TaxoMFM通过分类学感知编码和层级组成重建，联合学习跨分类阶元的丰度模式以及组内的相对比例。我们进一步构建了TaxoGut-HPP基准数据集，包含来自231个源队列的100,806份肠道微生物组图谱，涵盖40个分类任务和8个回归任务。TaxoMFM在疾病、肠道健康、宿主性状以及肝脏超声表型预测方面均取得了具有竞争力的性能。在跨队列零样本迁移设置中（即目标队列在预训练和下游适应阶段均被排除），TaxoMFM在结直肠癌、2型糖尿病和炎症（原文在此处截断）上分别取得了0.838、0.736和0.722的AUROC。
tldr: TaxoMFM是一个将分类学层级结构整合进自监督学习的人类肠道微生物组基础模型，通过分类学感知编码和层级组成重建，在疾病与健康预测任务及跨队列零样本迁移中均表现优异，并配套构建了包含10万余样本的大规模基准数据集TaxoGut-HPP。
